hero.eyebrow: ABOUT GOLDEN LAMP LEADERSHIP INITIATIVE AFRICA
hero.title: Building Leaders. Advancing Healthcare. Transforming Africa.
hero.description: Golden Lamp Leadership Initiative Africa is committed to developing effective leaders, advancing nursing research, promoting evidence-based practice, and creating opportunities that strengthen individuals, organizations, and communities across Africa.

story.title: From an Idea to a Growing Leadership Movement
story.description: How GLLIA evolved from a vision into a growing movement for nursing leadership and research across Africa.

timeline.title: The Beginning
timeline.subtitle: How It All Started
timeline.description: GLLIA was founded with a clear mission: to address the leadership gap in African healthcare. The founders recognized that strong leadership and research capacity were essential for transforming health systems across the continent.

timeline.title: Building the Foundation
timeline.subtitle: Early Programmes & Growth
timeline.description: GLLIA launched its first leadership development programmes, bringing together healthcare professionals, students, and mentors. Community engagement and capacity-building initiatives began to take shape across Nigeria.

timeline.title: Advancing Nursing Research
timeline.subtitle: Research & Mentorship
timeline.description: GLLIA developed structured nursing research programmes and mentorship opportunities, creating pathways for students and professionals to build research capacity, present their work, and contribute to evidence-based practice.

timeline.title: From Research to Practice
timeline.subtitle: Evidence-Based Practice
timeline.description: GLLIA expanded its focus to include evidence-based practice and professional development, helping healthcare professionals translate research findings into practical solutions for patient care and community health.

timeline.title: The Future
timeline.subtitle: A Stronger Generation of Leaders
timeline.description: GLLIA's vision is to develop a stronger generation of healthcare leaders across Africa, equipped with the skills, knowledge, and networks to transform health systems and improve outcomes for communities across the continent.

drives.title: Our Work Is Built Around Three Principles

principles.title: Leadership
principles.description: Developing capable, ethical and visionary leaders who can create meaningful change in healthcare and communities across Africa.

principles.title: Research
principles.description: Strengthening nursing research and developing the next generation of researchers who will drive evidence-based practice and innovation.

principles.title: Impact
principles.description: Turning knowledge and evidence into practical solutions for healthcare and communities, creating lasting change that improves lives.

visionMission.mission: Providing Access to Resources That Promote Growth and Development.
visionMission.missionDescription: We further our mission by providing access to resources that promote growth and development in Africa for both organizations and individuals.

peopleHeart.title: People That Are at the Heart of Our Work
peopleHeart.description: From students beginning their research journey to experienced professionals sharing their knowledge, GLLIA is built around a community committed to learning, leadership and impact.

founder.title: The Founder's Story
founder.name: Mrs. Oluyemisi Otitoloju
founder.description: Oluyemisi Otitoloju is a healthcare and leadership-development advocate focused on strengthening nursing education, research, evidence-based healthcare practice, and leadership development across Africa.
founder.description2: Through GLLIA, she works to develop future healthcare leaders, strengthen research capacity among nursing students and professionals, promote evidence-based practice, and support healthcare-focused community development.
